title: Semagram dictionary
description: Shape of dictionary/core.json and dictionary/packs/*.json. The invariants are enforced without a dependency by tests/test_semagram.py::test_dictionary_shape; this file exists so editors can validate and complete entries.

version.description: Bumped when the dictionary changes in a way that invalidates earlier translations.

name.description: Pack name; matches the filename and the `# pack:` line.

glyph.description: One glyph, with or without a variation selector; compared normalized, so 🏷 and 🏷️ collide.

class.description: Pictures are content (root), shapes are grammar (the rest). Design rule 4.

en.description: Slash-separated alternates; the first wins in the encoder. A [bracketed] gloss is grammar, not a word, and is skipped by the reverse index.

layer.description: 0 = NSM semantic prime, 1 = core root, 2 = domain pack.

transparency.description: Design rule: content roots must be translucent or better; opaque is capped to grammar particles. 'bound' is reserved for runtime ≔ bindings and does not appear on disk.

nsm.description: The Layer 0 expression this root abbreviates.

compounds.description: Declared multi-glyph words. Under the no-break rule a reader can only segment what is already declared, so free compounding does not exist.

glyphs.description: Head first. At most 3 roots, modifiers not counted.
